title: Husqvarna Japan Limited - proposed acquisition of Zenoah Company Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Husqvarna Japan Limited proposes to acquire all of Komatsu Zenoah Company's equity interests in  Zenoah Company Limited
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the context of separate national markets for the wholesale supply of: chainsaws; trimmers and brush-cutters; hedge trimmers; hand-held blowers and backpack blowers.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 27 March 2007, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the increase in the merged firm's market shares for each of the relevant products would be relatively small; and - there would remain a number of alternative suppliers for each of the relevant products to which customers could turn.
